tasks.detail:
Goal: Prove the change is green, minimal and confined to the intended files, by difference against `.ppm/system-prompt-markdown-panel/baseline.txt` rather than an enumerated allow-list or an absolute snapshot, and report the evidence.
Files: none — this task must not modify anything (no test edits, no formatting, no `next build`, no `git add`/`checkout`/`clean`, no edits to `eslint.config.mjs` and no deletion of `.next-old-*`).
Contract: every result goes into `progress` with its exit status and counts. On any red check, report the verbatim output as a failure; do not work around it.
Steps:
1. Targeted suites: `node --experimental-strip-types --test lib/system-prompt-markdown.test.mjs`, `node --experimental-strip-types --test components/SystemPromptPanel.test.mjs`, `node --experimental-strip-types --test lib/i18n/registry.test.mjs` -> 0 failures each.
2. `npx tsc --noEmit` -> exit 0 (the baseline `## checks` value).
3. `npx eslint lib/system-prompt-markdown.ts lib/system-prompt-markdown.test.mjs components/SystemPromptPanel.tsx components/SystemPromptPanel.test.mjs lib/i18n/messages/en.ts lib/i18n/messages/zh-CN.ts lib/i18n/messages/zh-TW.ts` -> exit 0. That is seven paths — one per file this plan writes. NEVER run `npm run lint` or `eslint .`: on this tree it walks the untracked `.next-old-20261026-130819/` directory that `eslint.config.mjs` does not ignore (measured: no completion within 600 s; audit: exit 134 heap OOM at the default heap, exit 1 with 7054 errors at a 6 GB heap). `eslint.config.mjs` and `.next-old-*` are OUT OF SCOPE — do not fix them, do not delete them, and do not report their state as a failure of this plan.
4. `npm test` -> the ONLY failure allowed is the one the baseline recorded, `lib/web-auth.test.mjs:14` (password authentication, `isWebPasswordEnabled(undefined)`). Both new test files must pass. Report the `tests`/`pass`/`fail`/`skipped` counts and compare them with the baseline; the tree is shared with another in-flight feature, so absolute totals may have risen — a failure other than the baseline's one, or a failing new test, fails this task. Do not touch `lib/web-auth.test.mjs` or `lib/web-auth.ts`.
5. Write scope by difference: `git status --porcelain=v1` compared with the baseline `## status` section, and `git diff --stat` compared with `## diffstat`. Expected delta, and nothing else: new porcelain entries `?? lib/system-prompt-markdown.ts`, `?? lib/system-prompt-markdown.test.mjs`, `?? components/SystemPromptPanel.test.mjs`; `components/SystemPromptPanel.tsx` gains a ` M` line and a `## diffstat` entry (it was tracked and clean in the baseline); the three `lib/i18n/messages/*.ts` files keep their existing ` M` lines while each one's added-line count (`git diff --numstat -- <file> | cut -f1`) grows by exactly 4 over its baseline `## perfile` `added=` value — the numstat column, never `git diff | wc -l`, which grows by 11 for the same four keys because they open a fresh hunk; and `.ppm/system-prompt-markdown-panel/baseline.txt` changes NO porcelain line, because `?? .ppm/system-prompt-markdown-panel/` is a collapsed untracked-directory line that was already in the baseline. Everything OUTSIDE those seven plan-owned paths is drift from the sibling feature in flight: record its `git status` / `git diff --stat` lines in `progress` as an observation and do NOT fail this task on them (a `components/AppShell.tsx` edit from that feature is likely, not a defect here). Still run `grep -n "<SystemPromptPanel" -A 5 components/AppShell.tsx` and confirm it passes exactly `loading`, `prompt`, `translate`, and confirm `git status --porcelain demo` is empty.
6. Contract reads: `grep -nE '\(\?<[=!]' lib/system-prompt-markdown.ts components/SystemPromptPanel.tsx` -> no output; `grep -n "system-prompt-text" components/SystemPromptPanel.tsx` -> no output; `grep -nE '#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,6}\b|rgba?\(' components/SystemPromptPanel.tsx` -> no output; `grep -c 'new Set(defaultSchema.tagNames ?? \[\])' lib/system-prompt-markdown.ts` -> 1; `grep -c "useMemo(" components/SystemPromptPanel.tsx` -> 1; `grep -n "<SystemPromptPanel" -A 5 components/AppShell.tsx` -> still exactly `loading`, `prompt`, `translate` at `components/AppShell.tsx:2515-2519`.
7. Behavioural sanity without a browser: parse a fixture built from `demo/mock/system-prompt.ts`'s `SYSTEM_PROMPT_TEMPLATE` (read only) with a synthetic `<mcp_servers>` section appended, print `kind/name/depth/label/lineOriented` per segment, and confirm document order tools, rules, docs, project_context, project_instructions (with `path=...`), skills, available_skills, skill, cwd, mcp_servers, no child before its parent, `lineOriented === false` for the AGENTS.md body at depth 2, and that no `br`/`div`/`details`/`img`-style prose line produced a section.
8. Manual, recorded as a human step and NOT as a guarantee: ask the user to run `npm run dev`, open the top bar's System panel at 390x844, and confirm the header is usable, Expand grows the panel to the popover's edge with ONE scrollbar — either the popover's outer one or the panel's inner `.system-prompt-scroll`; record which one you see, and do not expect a single inner scrollbar — the labels read tools / rules / docs / project context / skills / cwd / mcp servers, and Copy yields the raw prompt. Record as `manual: awaiting user confirmation`; do not fail the task if it is unattended, but do not claim it passed either.
Verify: the commands above are the verification.
Done when: steps 1-7 are green with their outputs and counts recorded in `progress`, the baseline comparison shows only the expected additions, and the manual step is recorded as pending or confirmed — never asserted.
